scope: One actual pre-release draft crop defect and its bounded repair; no claim about all new supplemental crops or other warnings.

records.observation: The actual 650x171 native-source crop included the complete left paragraph segment plus an unrelated clipped folio fragment at its lower-right boundary. Exact RGB correspondence did not prove glyph-safe crop boundaries.
records.resolution: The 650x135 native-source crop fd13f5d51d4f527d8887c31627d39ce224c33ccd810a78bd8b01ba204f8aa3fc excludes the unrelated fragment, preserves every paragraph glyph, retains the stable region ID and separate right-column continuation. Three generated left-specific field tuples must be regenerated canonically; all 120 supplemental targets remain pending.

privateBeforeEvidence.availability: Preserved privately; this defect was found before publication.

records.limitations: Crop and focus only. The left crop alone is not the complete paragraph. Context adequacy, default selection, target mapping, numeric values and mechanics remain separate unassessed dimensions.
